# 使用方式与复现边界

<!-- completed-manuscript-rerun-provenance -->
**当前数值版本：**内嵌的 1,020 项结果中，论文主表的 360 项已更新为本次完整重跑所得的数值（每项 $R=1000$、$B=1000$，来源标记 `rerun_main_20261006`）；其余 660 项仍是历史扩展归档，未在本次重跑。默认 `archived` 模式只重建已保存结果，不重新模拟。用于正式计算的原始 Rmd 输入和检查点保持冻结；恢复原运行应使用对应的冻结输入，不能用更新后全文摘要不同的文件覆盖它。
<!-- /completed-manuscript-rerun-provenance -->

本文件提供两种明确区分的工作方式。默认 Knit 为 **`archived`**：读取本文档内嵌的归档数值，检查后重建论文表格；论文主表的内嵌数值已与本次完整重跑结果及更新后的 LaTeX 逐项核对，**不声称重新生成了原始随机样本**。将 `mode` 改成 **`rerun`**，才会执行本文件内嵌的 R 模拟程序。

早期历史归档记录主种子为 `20260925`，但当时未保留原始 R 代码、随机数子流映射、逐次样本或逐次 p 值。因此，新代码可以复现**数据生成机制、检验程序和模拟设计**，不能承诺逐位再现原来的一千次随机实验。这里不搜索种子以拟合表格，也不把归档数值当成新模拟输出。

本 Rmd 可以单独复制、单独 Knit，不依赖任何配套 R、CSV 或 TeX 文件。模拟函数和 1,020 项归档数值均内嵌在文末附录。只需安装 `rmarkdown`、`knitr` 并具备 Pandoc；统计计算本身使用 base R。新生成的数据和检查点默认写到上一级的 `simulation_results/`，不会重建旧的辅助目录。Knit 生成的 HTML 可以在读完后删除，Rmd 仍可再次生成它。

```{r usage, eval=FALSE}
# 先跑小规模检查；不是论文精度的结果。
rmarkdown::render(
  "01_reproduce_tables.Rmd",
  params = list(mode = "rerun", profile = "smoke", R = 20, B = 99),
  output_file = "01_reproduce_smoke.html"
)

# 论文全部 360 个结果：180 个数据场景，每个场景同时计算 k=1 和 k=3。
rmarkdown::render(
  "01_reproduce_tables.Rmd",
  params = list(mode = "rerun", profile = "manuscript", R = 1000, B = 1000, workers = 1),
  output_file = "01_reproduce_full.html"
)

# 连同扩展表格的全部 1,020 个结果。
rmarkdown::render(
  "01_reproduce_tables.Rmd",
  params = list(mode = "rerun", profile = "archive", R = 1000, B = 1000, workers = 1),
  output_file = "01_reproduce_archive_grid.html"
)
```

# 与 V5 一致的模拟设计

两组样本量均为 $m$，均值为零，共用协方差矩阵 $\Sigma$。每一行是独立观测，维度为 $p$。用 **对称正定平方根**进行变换 $W=\Sigma^{1/2}Z$，没有将它替换为 Cholesky 因子。

| 代码 | 标准化向量 $Z$ |
|:---|:---|
| N | 独立标准正态坐标 |
| T | $\sqrt{6/Q}H$，$Q\sim\chi^2_8$，$H\sim N(0,I_p)$；同一观测的所有坐标共用一个 $Q$ |
| E | $\sqrt{E}H$，$E\sim\operatorname{Exp}(1)$；每行共用一个混合变量 |
| G | $\sqrt{V}H$，$V\sim\operatorname{Gamma}(3,1/3)$，第二个参数是 scale；每行共用一个混合变量 |
| L | 独立标准 logistic 坐标乘以 $\sqrt{3}/\pi$ |

| 协方差 | 定义 |
|:---|:---|
| C1 | $I_p$ |
| C2 | 第 $(i,j)$ 项为 $0.5^{|i-j|}$ |
| C3 | 前五个对角元为 4，其余为 1 |
| C4 | 第一个块大小为 4，其余块大小为 2；每块为 $0.4I_d+0.6J_d$ |

全部 15 对分布包括五个同分布对及十个异分布对。它们都满足协方差相等的 $H_0$；只有同分布对提供可交换的对照情形。

论文主表使用 $(p,m)=(10,50),(10,150),(40,150)$，分别计算 $k=1,3$。扩展表还包括 $p=20,40$、$m=50,150$ 和 $k=1,2,\min\{\lfloor\log m\rfloor,\lfloor p/2\rfloor\}$。

每次重复中，样本协方差分母为 $m-1$，重新计算各组样本均值。统计量为 $\sqrt m$ 乘以协方差差矩阵最大 $k$ 个**绝对特征值**之和。每次置换从合并的原始观测中等概率选出 $m$ 个归入第一组；不同置换之间独立抽样。右尾 p 值采用

$$\widehat p=\frac{1+\sum_{b=1}^B\mathbf 1\{T_b\geq T_{\rm obs}\}}{B+1},\qquad
\text{reject if }\widehat p\leq\alpha.$$

同一场景、同一次重复的所有 $k$ 共用数据和置换分组。代码通过组内一阶、二阶和计算居中协方差，代数上等价于逐次调用 `cov()`。全体方法的随机种子方案在本文档内嵌的模拟引擎中固定，逐次种子由主种子、场景、重复编号和用途确定；更改执行顺序或 CPU 数不改变结果。

# 核对并重建归档

```{r archived-data}
archived <- read_archived_results()
manuscript_archived <- select_manuscript(archived)
# 独立正文记录已同步至已完成的 360 项主表重跑；用场景键核对，避免依赖行序。
paper <- read.csv(text = .slads_manuscript_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ii <- match(archive_key(paper), archive_key(archived))
stopifnot(
  nrow(paper) == 360L, !anyNA(ii),
  all(paper$rejection_rate == archived$rejection_rate[ii]),
  all(paper$mcse == archived$mcse[ii])
)
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Item = c("完整归档结果数", "论文主表结果数", "重复次数 R", "置换次数 B"),
  Value = c(nrow(archived), nrow(manuscript_archived), 1000, 1000)
))
```

# 执行所选模式

`rerun` 模式将配置、代码版本摘要、逐次 p 值、拒绝指示、汇总 CSV 和 R 会话信息保存到输出目录，每 10 次重复保存检查点。同一输入文件、同一配置下可接续已完成部分。运行目录由配置及 **Rmd 全文摘要**确定，因此修改注释或排版也会生成新的运行目录；恢复旧运行须使用对应的冻结输入。`workers` 默认设为 1，最多使用 7 个工作进程，并将每个进程的 BLAS/OpenMP 线程数设为 1；Windows 下串行执行。完整运行前可用 smoke 模式估计耗时。

```{r run}
if (params$mode == "archived") {
  result <- NULL
  table_data <- if (params$profile == "archive") archived else manuscript_archived
  result_dir <- file.path(params$output_root, "archived")
  dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  write.csv(table_data, file.path(result_dir, "archived_table_values.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  provenance <- "已保存结果重建：当前论文 360 项来自完整重跑，其余 660 项为历史归档；本次 Knit 未重新模拟"
} else {
  grid <- slads_grid(params$profile)
  result <- slads_run(
    grid, R = params$R, B = params$B, alpha = params$alpha, seed = params$seed,
    workers = params$workers, resume = params$resume, output_root = params$output_root
  )
  table_data <- result$summary
  table_data$k <- as.integer(sub("KyFan_k", "", table_data$method, fixed = TRUE))
  table_data$R <- params$R
  table_data$B <- params$B
  result_dir <- result$directory
  provenance <- "本次 R 程序重新模拟；并非原始随机数子流"
}
write_paper_tex(table_data, file.path(result_dir, "tables.tex"))
cat("结果来源：", provenance, "\n输出目录：", result_dir, "\n")
```

# 表格

每项为拒绝比例（Monte Carlo 标准误）。归档表的 $R=B=1000$、$\alpha=0.05$；重新模拟的数目以本次配置为准。smoke 模式只显示已运行的场景，其余位置用破折号表示，绝不补入归档结果。

```{r tables, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
groups <- unique(table_data[c("p", "m", "k")])
for (i in seq_len(nrow(groups))) {
  g <- groups[i, ]
  cat(sprintf("\n\n## p=%d, m=%d, k=%d\n\n", g$p, g$m, g$k))
  print(knitr::kable(
    format_paper_table(table_data, g$p, g$m, g$k), align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c")
  ))
}
```

# 重新运行与内嵌结果的差异

下表只在 `rerun` 模式出现，比较重新计算结果与当前内嵌结果。论文主表的内嵌数值来自已完成的完整重跑；相同种子、实现和设计应复现这些结果。表中独立模拟差值标准误仅用于两次模拟独立时的解释，同一随机流的复现不以该误差作为容限。历史扩展场景仍可能因早期随机流缺失而与旧归档不同。

```{r differences}
if (!is.null(result)) {
  at <- match(archive_key(table_data), archive_key(archived))
  comparison <- table_data[c("p", "m", "covariance", "pair", "k", "rejection_rate", "mcse")]
  comparison$archived_rate <- archived$rejection_rate[at]
  comparison$difference <- comparison$rejection_rate - comparison$archived_rate
  old_exact_se <- sqrt(comparison$archived_rate * (1 - comparison$archived_rate) / 1000)
  comparison$independent_difference_mcse <- sqrt(comparison$mcse^2 + old_exact_se^2)
  write.csv(comparison, file.path(result_dir, "new_vs_archived.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  knitr::kable(head(comparison, 30), digits = 4)
}
```

```{r embedded-archive, eval=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
archive_key <- function(x) paste(x$p, x$m, x$covariance, x$pair, x$k, sep = ":")

read_archived_results <- function() {
  x <- read.csv(text = .slads_archive_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  x$R <- 1000L
  x$B <- 1000L
  x$alpha <- 0.05
  x$provenance <- ifelse(
    x$source == "rerun_main_20261006",
    "embedded_completed_rerun_manuscript", "embedded_historical_tex_values"
  )
  # Archived MCSEs were rounded to three decimals; allow half a rounding unit.
  stopifnot(
    nrow(x) == 1020L,
    !anyDuplicated(archive_key(x)),
    all(abs(x$mcse - sqrt(x$rejection_rate * (1 - x$rejection_rate) / 1000)) <= 0.00050001)
  )
  x$rejections <- as.integer(round(x$rejection_rate * x$R))
  x$exchangeable <- substr(x$pair, 1, 1) == substr(x$pair, 3, 3)
  x[order(x$p, x$m, x$k, match(x$pair, pair_levels), x$covariance), ]
}

select_manuscript <- function(x) {
  x[
    ((x$p == 10 & x$m %in% c(50, 150)) | (x$p == 40 & x$m == 150)) & x$k %in% c(1, 3),
  ]
}

format_paper_table <- function(x, p, m, k) {
  z <- x[x$p == p & x$m == m & x$k == k, ]
  out <- data.frame(Pair = pair_levels, check.names = FALSE)
  for (cv in paste0("C", 1:4)) {
    zz <- z[z$covariance == cv, ]
    ii <- match(pair_levels, zz$pair)
    # A partial rerun leaves absent scenarios visible instead of filling from the archive.
    out[[cv]] <- ifelse(
      is.na(ii), "—", sprintf("%.3f (%.3f)", zz$rejection_rate[ii], zz$mcse[ii])
    )
  }
  out
}

write_paper_tex <- function(x, file) {
  grids <- unique(x[c("p", "m", "k")])
  out <- character()
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(grids))) {
    g <- grids[i, ]
    t <- format_paper_table(x, g$p, g$m, g$k)
    t$Pair <- gsub("-", "--", t$Pair, fixed = TRUE)
    q <- x[x$p == g$p & x$m == g$m & x$k == g$k, , drop = FALSE]
    counts <- if (all(c("R", "B") %in% names(q))) {
      sprintf(" R=%d, B=%d.", q$R[1], q$B[1])
    } else {
      ""
    }
    out <- c(
      out, "\\begin{table}[htbp]", "\\centering",
      sprintf(
        "\\caption{Null rejection proportions (Monte Carlo standard errors): p=%d, m=%d, k=%d.%s}",
        g$p, g$m, g$k, counts
      ),
      "\\begin{tabular}{lcccc}", "\\toprule", "Pair & C1 & C2 & C3 & C4 \\\\",
      "\\midrule", apply(t, 1, function(r) paste0(paste(r, collapse = " & "), " \\\\")),
      "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tabular}", "\\end{table}", ""
    )
  }
  writeLines(out, file, useBytes = TRUE)
}
```

```{r embedded-core, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE}
# Base-R simulation engine; seeds depend on scenario, replicate and purpose.
# Keep the key encoding and RNG kinds fixed to preserve the simulation streams.
slads_seed <- function(master, ...) {
  key <- paste(..., collapse = "|")
  h <- as.double(master %% 2147483646)
  for (v in utf8ToInt(key)) h <- (131 * h + v) %% 2147483646
  as.integer(h + 1)
}

slads_set_seed <- function(seed) {
  RNGkind("Mersenne-Twister", "Inversion", "Rejection")
  set.seed(seed)
}

slads_covariance <- function(p, model = "C1") {
  stopifnot(p >= 5L, p == as.integer(p))
  if (model == "C1")
    return(diag(p))
  if (model == "C2")
    return(0.5^abs(outer(seq_len(p), seq_len(p), "-")))
  if (model == "C3")
    return(diag(c(rep(4, 5), rep(1, p - 5))))
  if (model == "C4") {
    stopifnot(p %% 2L == 0L)
    S <- diag(p)
    start <- 1L
    # One four-coordinate block, followed by two-coordinate blocks.
    for (d in c(4L, rep(2L, (p - 4L) / 2L))) {
      ii <- seq.int(start, length.out = d)
      S[ii, ii] <- 0.4 * diag(d) + 0.6
      start <- start + d
    }
    return(S)
  }
  if (model == "SPIKE10")
    return(diag(c(10, rep(1, p - 1))))
  stop("Unknown covariance model: ", model)
}

slads_sqrt <- function(Sigma) {
  # The design specifies the symmetric positive-definite root of Sigma.
  e <- eigen(Sigma, symmetric = TRUE)
  stopifnot(min(e$values) > 0)
  tcrossprod(sweep(e$vectors, 2L, sqrt(e$values), "*"), e$vectors)
}

slads_draw <- function(n, law, sqrt_sigma) {
  # Each row is one observation; all laws have standardized covariance I_p.
  p <- ncol(sqrt_sigma)
  if (law == "L") {
    Z <- matrix(rlogis(n * p), n, p) * sqrt(3) / pi
  } else {
    Z <- matrix(rnorm(n * p), n, p)
    scale <- switch(
      law,
      N = rep(1, n),
      T = sqrt(6 / rchisq(n, 8)),
      E = sqrt(rexp(n)),
      G = sqrt(rgamma(n, shape = 3, scale = 1 / 3)),
      stop("Unknown standardized law: ", law)
    )
    # R recycles the length-n vector down each column, sharing one scale per row.
    Z <- Z * scale
  }
  Z %*% sqrt_sigma
}

# Position k contains the sum of the k largest absolute eigenvalues.
kyfan_curve <- function(D) cumsum(sort(
  abs(eigen(D, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values), decreasing = TRUE
))

kyfan_permutation <- function(X, Y, ks = c(1L, 3L), B = 1000L,
                             keep_spectra = FALSE, assignments = NULL) {
  # X and Y have m rows and p columns. Optional assignments contain one
  # size-m subset of pooled row indices per permutation and override B.
  stopifnot(
    is.matrix(X), is.matrix(Y), nrow(X) == nrow(Y), ncol(X) == ncol(Y),
    all(is.finite(X)), all(is.finite(Y))
  )
  m <- nrow(X)
  p <- ncol(X)
  ks <- sort(unique(as.integer(ks)))
  stopifnot(m > 1L, all(ks >= 1L & ks <= p), B >= 1L)
  Z <- rbind(X, Y)
  # Global centering is algebraically neutral and improves numerical stability.
  Z <- sweep(Z, 2L, colMeans(Z), "-")
  total_sum <- colSums(Z)
  total_cross <- crossprod(Z)
  spectrum <- function(ii) {
    A <- Z[ii, , drop = FALSE]
    a <- colSums(A)
    b <- total_sum - a
    AA <- crossprod(A)
    # Recover both centered covariances from pooled sums; both use denominator m - 1.
    D <- (2 * AA - total_cross - (tcrossprod(a) - tcrossprod(b)) / m) / (m - 1)
    kyfan_curve(D)
  }
  observed <- spectrum(seq_len(m))
  if (!is.null(assignments)) {
    stopifnot(is.matrix(assignments), ncol(assignments) == m)
    B <- nrow(assignments)
  }
  out <- matrix(NA_real_, B, if (keep_spectra) p else length(ks))
  for (b in seq_len(B)) {
    ii <- if (is.null(assignments)) {
      sample.int(2L * m, m, replace = FALSE)
    } else {
      assignments[b, ]
    }
    if (!is.null(assignments)) {
      stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(ii), all(ii >= 1 & ii <= 2 * m))
    }
    v <- spectrum(ii)
    out[b, ] <- if (keep_spectra) v else v[ks]
  }
  chosen <- if (keep_spectra) out[, ks, drop = FALSE] else out
  # sqrt(m) is positive and common, so unscaled comparisons give identical p-values.
  # Count ties in the right tail and apply the same plus-one correction for every k.
  pv <- (1 + colSums(sweep(chosen, 2L, observed[ks], ">="))) / (B + 1)
  names(pv) <- paste0("k", ks)
  list(p_value = pv, statistic = setNames(sqrt(m) * observed[ks], names(pv)), observed = observed,
    perm = sqrt(m) * chosen, perm_spectra = if (keep_spectra) out else NULL, B = B, ks = ks)
}

slads_grid <- function(profile = c("manuscript", "archive", "smoke", "spectral")) {
  profile <- match.arg(profile)
  if (profile == "smoke") {
    g <- data.frame(p = 10L, m = 50L, covariance = c("C1", "C1", "C3", "C4"), pair = c("N-N",
      "N-T", "E-E", "N-L"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    g$ks <- "1,3"
  } else if (profile == "spectral") {
    # Distinct supplementary designs: H0 is retained in every case.
    g <- data.frame(p = c(100L, 100L, 500L, 500L), m = 100L, covariance = c("SPIKE10",
      "SPIKE10", "C1", "C1"), pair = c("N-N", "L-L", "N-N", "L-L"), ks = "1,3", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else {
    a <- read_archived_results()
    if (profile == "manuscript")
      a <- select_manuscript(a)
    # One scenario produces all its requested k values from shared draws and permutations.
    g <- unique(a[c("p", "m", "covariance", "pair")])
    g$ks <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(g)), function(i) {
      z <- g[i, ]
      paste(sort(unique(a$k[a$p == z$p & a$m == z$m & a$covariance == z$covariance &
        a$pair == z$pair])), collapse = ",")
    }, character(1))
  }
  g$law_x <- substr(g$pair, 1, 1)
  g$law_y <- substr(g$pair, 3, 3)
  g$exchangeable <- g$law_x == g$law_y
  g$scenario <- with(g, paste0("p", p, "_m", m, "_", covariance, "_", pair))
  rownames(g) <- NULL
  g
}

slads_hash <- function(x) {
  f <- tempfile()
  on.exit(unlink(f))
  saveRDS(x, f, version = 2)
  unname(tools::md5sum(f))
}

slads_code_hash <- function() {
  # Hash the entire source, including comments and embedded data. Even formatting
  # creates a new run ID; resume a historical run with its frozen Rmd input.
  unname(tools::md5sum(.slads_input_path))
}

slads_write_rds <- function(x, path) {
  # Commit only after serialization finishes, keeping the previous checkpoint intact.
  temp <- paste0(path, ".tmp-", Sys.getpid())
  saveRDS(x, temp)
  if (!file.rename(temp, path))
    stop("Cannot commit checkpoint: ", path)
}

slads_wilson <- function(s, n, level = 0.95) {
  # Binomial interval for s rejections among n valid repetitions.
  if (n < 1L)
    return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  z <- qnorm(1 - (1 - level) / 2)
  ph <- s / n
  d <- 1 + z * z / n
  mid <- (ph + z * z / (2 * n)) / d
  half <- z * sqrt(ph * (1 - ph) / n + z * z / (4 * n * n)) / d
  c(max(0, mid - half), min(1, mid + half))
}

slads_summary <- function(raw, alpha = 0.05) {
  groups <- split(raw, interaction(raw$scenario, raw$method, drop = TRUE, lex.order = TRUE))
  result <- lapply(groups, function(d) {
    # Failures and inapplicable methods remain counted but do not enter the rate.
    ok <- d$status == "ok" & !is.na(d$reject)
    n <- sum(ok)
    s <- sum(d$reject[ok])
    ci <- slads_wilson(s, n)
    rate <- if (n) s / n else NA_real_
    data.frame(
      d[1, c("scenario", "p", "m", "covariance", "pair", "exchangeable", "method")],
      requested = nrow(d), valid = n, not_applicable = sum(d$status == "not_applicable"),
      failed = sum(!ok & d$status != "not_applicable"), rejections = s, rejection_rate = rate,
      mcse = if (n) sqrt(rate * (1 - rate) / n) else NA_real_,
      ci_low = ci[1], ci_high = ci[2], alpha = alpha, mean_seconds = mean(d$seconds),
      row.names = NULL
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, result)
}

slads_run <- function(grid, R = 1000L, B = 1000L, alpha = 0.05, seed = 20260925L,
                      workers = 1L, output_root = "outputs", resume = TRUE,
                      checkpoint_every = 10L) {
  # This runner produces KyFan tables; method comparisons are in 02_compare_methods_H0.Rmd.
  stopifnot(R >= 1L, R == as.integer(R), B >= 19L, alpha > 0, alpha < 1)
  # Avoid nested BLAS/OpenMP parallelism inside the scenario workers.
  Sys.setenv(
    OMP_NUM_THREADS = "1", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS = "1", MKL_NUM_THREADS = "1",
    VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS = "1", BLIS_NUM_THREADS = "1", RCPP_PARALLEL_NUM_THREADS = "1"
  )
  if (requireNamespace("RhpcBLASctl", quietly = TRUE)) {
    RhpcBLASctl::blas_set_num_threads(1L)
    RhpcBLASctl::omp_set_num_threads(1L)
  }
  config <- list(
    grid = grid, R = R, B = B, alpha = alpha, seed = seed, code_hash = slads_code_hash(),
    R_version = as.character(getRversion()),
    rng = "Mersenne-Twister/Inversion/Rejection", engine = "1.1-standalone"
  )
  run_id <- paste0("reproduce_", substr(slads_hash(config), 1, 12))
  outdir <- file.path(output_root, run_id)
  dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  saveRDS(config, file.path(outdir, "configuration.rds"))
  writeLines(capture.output(str(config)), file.path(outdir, "configuration.txt"))
  # Each scenario owns a checkpoint containing its completed replicate rows.
  one_scenario <- function(i) {
    g <- grid[i, , drop = FALSE]
    file <- file.path(outdir, paste0(g$scenario, ".rds"))
    done <- if (resume && file.exists(file)) readRDS(file) else list()
    if (length(done) > R)
      stop("Checkpoint larger than requested run.")
    root <- slads_sqrt(slads_covariance(g$p, g$covariance))
    ks <- as.integer(strsplit(g$ks, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
    if (length(done) < R) {
      for (r in seq.int(length(done) + 1L, R)) {
        # Separate data and permutation streams make execution order irrelevant.
        slads_set_seed(slads_seed(seed, g$scenario, r, "data"))
        X <- slads_draw(g$m, g$law_x, root)
        Y <- slads_draw(g$m, g$law_y, root)
        slads_set_seed(slads_seed(seed, g$scenario, r, "permutation"))
        tm <- system.time(ky <- kyfan_permutation(X, Y, ks, B))["elapsed"]
        rows <- data.frame(
          method = paste0("KyFan_k", ks), p_value = unname(ky$p_value),
          statistic = unname(ky$statistic), reject = unname(ky$p_value) <= alpha,
          status = "ok", detail = "", seconds = unname(tm), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
        for (nm in c("scenario", "p", "m", "covariance", "pair", "exchangeable")) {
          rows[[nm]] <- g[[nm]]
        }
        rows$replicate <- r
        rows$data_seed <- slads_seed(seed, g$scenario, r, "data")
        done[[r]] <- rows
        if (r %% checkpoint_every == 0L || r == R) {
          slads_write_rds(done, file)
        }
      }
    }
    message(g$scenario, ": ", R, " repetitions complete")
    do.call(rbind, done)
  }
  workers <- as.integer(workers)
  if (is.na(workers) || workers < 1L)
    workers <- 1L
  workers <- min(workers, 7L)
  if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows" && workers > 1L) {
    warning("Windows uses serial execution; set workers=1.")
    workers <- 1L
  }
  # Each replicate sets its own seed; fork workers must not replace those streams.
  all <- if (workers > 1L) {
    parallel::mclapply(
      seq_len(nrow(grid)), one_scenario,
      mc.cores = min(workers, nrow(grid)), mc.set.seed = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), one_scenario)
  }
  if (any(vapply(all, inherits, logical(1), "try-error")))
    stop("A worker failed; see checkpoints.")
  raw <- do.call(rbind, all)
  rownames(raw) <- NULL
  summary <- slads_summary(raw, alpha)
  write.csv(raw, file.path(outdir, "replicates.csv"), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  write.csv(summary, file.path(outdir, "summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(outdir, "sessionInfo.txt"))
  list(raw = raw, summary = summary, config = config, directory = outdir)
}
```
